resources.string: On your computer, open GeekBridge and click “Link a phone”. Then scan the code it shows.
Scan QR code from my computer
No QR scanner app is installed. Use the camera app or paste the link instead.
Or point your phone’s own camera app at the code and tap the GeekBridge link it shows. GeekBridge opens the camera only on the Scan screen, never in the background.

Another app or web page opened this pairing link. Nothing connects until you tap Continue, and you still approve the pairing after that. Only continue if you just clicked “Link a phone” on your own computer.
You scanned the code on a computer’s screen. Nothing connects until you tap Continue, and you still approve the pairing after that. The name below comes from the code; check it is your computer.
The full fingerprint is shown again when you approve; it must match your computer’s. If you did not start this yourself, cancel.
Checking that this is the computer in the QR code. You will be asked to confirm.

Try the clipboard: on Home, scroll to Settings and turn on Clipboard sync. Copy some text on this phone, then on your computer open Clipboard and click Paste from phone (or press Ctrl+Shift+V in that window).
Send a file: first, on your computer, open Share files and tick “Allow this phone to send me files”. Then pick one below, or use Share → Send to computer in any app.
No file picker is available on this phone.
Scan QR code from my computer
This is the computer you scanned: its identity matches the QR code, so there is no code to compare. Pair only if you started this on your own computer.
